title: Visual builder Tabs and Icon list modules

entries.summary: Catalog/normalize/render Tabs (radio+CSS panels) and Icon list. Accordion title/body sanitizer is reused for tabs. Icons and copy are HTML-escaped.
Custom inspectors use data-tabs-* and data-ilist-* (not carousel/accordion attrs). Canvas shows tab chips and icon rows. Add/remove rebuilds; field edits can live-patch.
No schema change. Tab and icon-list items live in layout_json.
